messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — seeing intermittent 502s from prod-eu on /api/generate since ~23:45 UTC. isolated to long header values. pushed tiny guard (sha b7c9f1, PR #412) that trims/normalizes the offending header. no DB or config change. requesting expedited deploy in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window.

releasebot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-b7c9f1. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 5m -> 30% for 3m -> 100% if healthy. Please ACK with +1 from owners/oncall. Release owner: morgan.

ash (eng-oncall): +1. Ran staging smoke against the hotfix image; sample smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status` -> 200. No encoder warnings in logs.

tara (sre): +1. I'll prep rollback commands and watch LB error spikes, pod restarts, and ingress qlen during rollout. Two quick rollback options below.

Rollback (image swap fast revert):
```bash
kubectl -n prod-eu set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu
```

Rollback (rollout undo to stable rev):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=214
```

leo (qa): Staging smoke passed. I'll watch 5xx rate, p50/p95, and token-encoding warnings during canary. Draft release note: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/b7c9f1-draft

morgan: scheduled canary for 00:33 UTC (within window). tagging @tara @ash for watch.

releasebot: Canary started at 00:33 UTC (5% traffic). Observability: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary.

ash: +3m into canary — no 5xx increase, p95 stable, KV hit-rate unchanged. traces show header normalization occurring as expected.

tara: recommend advance to 30% at +5m. hold an extra minute for long-lived sessions; will action rollback immediately on signal. :eyes:

releasebot: Promoting to 30% traffic at 00:38 UTC... promotion successful.

leo: 30% smoke OK. no encoder errors, no surge on ingress. ready for full at +2m if still clean.

morgan: promoting to full at 00:40 if no regressions.

releasebot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:40 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated. ✅

tara: dashboards green. no restarts, latencies within SLO. temporarily lowered burst limiter for the endpoint during rollout.

leo: final smoke passed. Published release note: "Hotfix b7c9f1: normalize long header values to prevent intermittent 502s in EU region." https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/b7c9f1

morgan: signed off and closing hotfix window. if anything crops up, use rollback commands above and ping #eng-oncall. big thanks for the speedy assist. :party_parrot:
